description: Parkeringsdata 2018 Stavanger is a dataset listed in National Data Catalog of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by opencom.no. Dasettet viser beleggsprosenten time for time i parkeringsanleggene Siddis,Forum,Jernbanen,Posten,Jorenholmen,St. Olav,Valberget,Kyrre og Parketten. Dataene går fram til 20.11.2018. Resterende data for 2018 vil bli lagt til datasettet i januar 2019. Det må tas forbehold om feil, da tellingen ofte må justeres manuelt av vektere. Coverage: NO. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2019-04-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD) 2.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-norge-no.
